votes.motion: To approve Minutes from the July 8, 2021 Planning Commission Meeting as presented

To recommend application #REZ2021-000363 for a Rezone from A-20 (Agricultural) to M-2 (Manufacturing) to the Magna Council for approval with staff recommendations and clarification to #4 prohibited permitted uses, allows for construction equipment repair
To approve application #CUP2021-000283 for a Conditional Use for a Restaurant with staff recommendations adding enhanced landscaping on the east side

To approve application #CUP2020-000038 for a Shared Parking Schedule for the Retail and Restaurant Uses (Mixed-Use project) and approval of two additional structures on the site plan (pavilions) previously approved for the subject property with staff recommendations and without the cross walk between the retail and market pads
